parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set firewall family inet6 filter input-f.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then policer [parameter3]
set firewall family inet6 filter input-f.command: set firewall family inet6 filter input-filter term traffic-policy-input then policer p1
set firewall family inet6 filter input-f.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的策略动作。

set firewall family inet6 filter access-.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from source-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set firewall family inet6 filter access-.command: set firewall family inet6 filter access-list-3003 term 1 from source-address 2001:db8::1:1112/126
set firewall family inet6 filter access-.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的源地址条件。

set firewall family inet6 filter access-.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from destination-address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set firewall family inet6 filter access-.command: set firewall family inet6 filter access-list-3003 term 1 from destination-address 64:FF9B::/96
set firewall family inet6 filter access-.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的目的地址条件。

set firewall family inet6 filter access-.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then accept
set firewall family inet6 filter access-.command: set firewall family inet6 filter access-list-3003 term 1 then accept
set firewall family inet6 filter access-.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的接受动作。

set firewall family inet6 filter class-m.template: set firewall family inet6 filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then accept
set firewall family inet6 filter class-m.command: set firewall family inet6 filter class-map-c1 term 1 then accept
set firewall family inet6 filter class-m.explanation: 配置IPv6防火墙过滤器的接受动作。
